title: Adequacy and Effectiveness of Oil Sighting and Alert Mechanisms, and Maritime Incident Response and Mitigation Strategies
what_it_is: Adequacy and Effectiveness of Oil Sighting and Alert Mechanisms, and Maritime Incident Response and Mitigation Strategies

sections.label: Questions on recent oil spills
sections.summary: Questions ask whether oil sighting and alert mechanisms need review and how multi-agency costs should be handled, plus impacts and MPA mitigation measures.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Transport with the recent increase in oil spill or leak incidents (a) whether a fundamental review is required for oil sighting and alert mechanisms given the local oil and gas industry and Singapore's status as a global bunkering hub; and (b) how should the cost and workload incurred by multi-agencies involved to manage each incident be dealt with.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Transport in view of the three recent oil spills into Singapore waters (a) what is the impact on our seawater quality and marine ecosystem; and (b) what are the mitigation measures that will be imposed by MPA to prevent and treat further occurrences of an oil spill.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: These questions pertain to the recent oil spill and leak incidents that occurred on 14 June, 20 October and 28 October this year.

sections.label: Causes of three oil spills
sections.summary: The 14 June incident was an allision at Pasir Panjang Terminal, 20 October a Shell pipeline leak at Pulau Bukom, and 28 October a bunkering overflow off Changi.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: The 14 June incident, as the Minister for Transport explained in great detail in his Ministerial Statement on 2 July 2024, was due to an allision between a dredger and a bunker tanker at Pasir Panjang Terminal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: The 20 October incident was the result of a leak in Shell's land-based pipeline at Pulau Bukom.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: The 28 October incident occurred due to an overflow of bunker fuel in the receiving vessel during a bunkering operation off Changi.

sections.label: Claims and crew charges
sections.summary: Agencies are consolidating compensation claims under the International Oil Pollution Compensation Fund, and four Vox Maxima crew members were charged under the Merchant Shipping Act 1995.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: Agencies are consolidating their claims for compensation under the International Oil Pollution Compensation Fund.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: MPA has also completed its investigations and assessed that key crew members of Vox Maxima, the dredger that allided with the bunker tanker Marine Honour, failed to discharge their duties properly on the day of the incident.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: Four crew members have just been charged in the State Courts for contraventions under the Merchant Shipping Act 1995.

sections.label: Post-incident lessons and improvements
sections.summary: After every oil spill, a study is done to draw lessons, improve existing plans and engage stakeholders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: After every oil spill, every incident, there will be a study to see what are the lessons that can be drawn and then we look to see how we can improve our plans that are in place as well and also engage the respective stakeholders.

sections.label: Improving oil spill response time
sections.summary: A robust contingency plan has been developed with industry players and is rehearsed and refined regularly, including in inter-agency exercises every two years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: Yes, just to clarify my question: are there any plans to continue to improve the response time of MPA's oil spill response contractor to future incidents of oil spills in our port waters?

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: We have worked with industry players to develop a robust contingency plan, which we rehearse and refine regularly, including during our inter-agency exercises for oil spills every two years.

sections.label: MPA Guardian booms equipment
sections.summary: The MPA Guardian is equipped with 260 metres of lightweight booms to deal quickly with small-scale and localised oil spills such as during bunkering.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: Currently, the MPA Guardian is equipped with 260 metres of lightweight booms to aid in dealing quickly with small-scale and localised oil spills, such as oil spills during bunkering operations.
